lines.en: Are you two sure you want to be on my reality show?
Yes. We had an emergency session with Dr. Susan,
"If you're sure you have no feelings for Carly whatsoever,
And any scene I'm not in, I'll sit on the side
with my arms crossed, watching closely.
To which I replied, "How can I say no?"
- Can I get a helmet? - Can you make that, too?
Carly, don't worry about the actual silken.
Uh, worry about being alone forever
because Freddie refuses to speak to you. Wow.
Is that what she told you?
